jobs.description:
Company Description
At Bosch, we care for you, our business, and our environment. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid. We grow together into countless roles, positions, and opportunities and we are interested in developing the “whole” you, not just the “9 to 5” you, because life is all about balance.
At Bosch, we celebrate you. Our people are what make us remarkable. Therefore we recognize your contribution with competitive salary packages, collective agreements with unions, occupational pension, and other attractive benefits, such as wellness contribution, smart work, flexible working hours, Gym & Yoga classes at site.
Let’s not forget the sincere “thank you” for our employees’ contribution. Our success is your success. Let’s celebrate together.
At Bosch we understand that everyone has their own focus in life, whether it is about new professional challenges, training, and development, or more time for family, friends, and hobbies, whatever your goals are we are flexible. Let ‘s strike a balance.
At Bosch, we believe everyone is different and that is what we love. Get inspired by a cooperative, open, respectful, and trustworthy workplace where you can be yourself and be enriched by the perspectives of our community around the globe.       
Job Description
Your contribution to something big 
You will take responsibility in the reporting process of the Business Unit Electric Solutions 
Creating and automating reports, dashboards, and presentations will also be in your area of responsibility 
You will analyze and optimize data flows and analyses on sales figures, forecasts, and others 
By evaluating data structures you will help identify ways to enhance business optimization 
You will support the Controlling department of the Heat Pump business in Europe in ad-hoc analyses 
Ensuring data quality and integrity will also be part of your duties 
You will contribute to the development of data models to tackle business challenges 

During your internship, the focus will be also on development opportunities by getting hands-on experience in financial planning and data analysis. You will gain in-depth knowledge of heat pump technology and be a part of advancing the green transition across Europe.  
Duration of the internship: 6 months, preferably starting in February 2027 
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden 
 
Qualifications
What distinguishes you 
Currently studying Business Administration, Data Engineering or similar 
Good knowledge in Microsoft Office Tools (esp. Excel and PowerPoint) 
Preferably knowledge in data warehousing concepts and Power BI  
Strong analytical skills and affinity for numbers 
Ability to take responsibility for your own work and apply your own initiative to find solutions 
Result-oriented and pro-active attitude 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English 

Additional Information
What we offer you
Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship
We can offer free accommodation in Tranås
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

Hemfrid är Sveriges ledande företag inom hemservice. Varje dag hjälper vi våra kunder att skapa en enklare vardag genom hemstädning, fönsterputs och andra tjänster i hemmet – alltid med kvalitet, omtanke och service i fokus.
Nu söker vi fler engagerade städare till Jönköping med omnejd. Hos oss blir du en del av ett internationellt team med kollegor från hela världen. Tillsammans skapar vi rena hem, nöjda kunder och en arbetsplats där du kan utvecklas.
Vad erbjuder vi?
En tjänst på 75 %

Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor

Fast månadslön – samma lön varje månad

Milersättning mellan kunder om du använder egen bil i tjänsten

Betald restid mellan kunder

Försäkringar (sjukförsäkring, ansvarsförsäkring och tjänstepension)

Friskvårdsbidrag på 2 400 kr per år

Gratis mobilabonnemang

Kostnadsfri utbildning inom hemstädning samt vidareutbildningar inom service och städning

Stöd från Field Lead/Buddy som finns där för att hjälpa dig i ditt arbete

Teamträffar och gemensamma aktiviteter

Hos Hemfrid får du en trygg arbetsgivare, möjligheter att utvecklas och ett arbete där din insats verkligen uppskattas.
Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig som:

Tycker om att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra

Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och har ett öga för detaljer

Har en positiv inställning och tycker om att ge god service

Vill utvecklas och lära dig nya saker

Talar svenska eller engelska

Kan arbeta vardagar mellan 08.00–17.00

Trivs med att arbeta hos olika kunder

Meriterande:

B-körkort (egen bil är en fördel)

Erfarenhet av städning eller serviceyrken

Ansök redan idag!
Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande och ser fram emot att höra från dig.
Läs mer och skicka in din ansökan på www.hemfrid.se/karriar
Har du frågor? Kontakta oss gärna på hr@hemfrid.se.
Välkommen till Hemfrid – tillsammans skapar vi en enklare vardag för våra kunder! ✨
HEMFRID IS LOOKING FOR CLEANERS IN JÖNKÖPING – JOIN HEMFRID!
Do you want a job where you make a real difference every day?
Hemfrid is Sweden's leading home services company. Every day, we help our customers simplify their lives through home cleaning, window cleaning, and other household services – always with quality, care, and outstanding service.
We are now looking for more dedicated cleaners in Jönköping and the surrounding area. At Hemfrid, you'll become part of an international team with colleagues from all over the world. Together, we create clean homes, satisfied customers, and a workplace where you can grow.
What do we offer?
A 75% permanent position

Collective agreement and secure employment terms

Fixed monthly salary

Mileage reimbursement between customers if you use your own car for work

Paid travel time between customers

Insurance (health, liability, and occupational pension)

Wellness allowance of SEK 2,400 per year

Free mobile phone subscription

Free training in home cleaning and continuous development within cleaning and customer service

Support from a dedicated Field Lead/Buddy

Team meetings and social events

At Hemfrid, you'll have the support, training, and opportunities you need to succeed and develop in your role.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone who:

Enjoys working independently as well as in a team

Is responsible, detail-oriented, and service-minded

Has a positive attitude and enjoys helping customers

Wants to learn and develop

Speaks Swedish or English

Can work Monday–Friday between 08:00 and 17:00

Is flexible and enjoys working at different customer locations

Meritorious:

Category B driver's license (own car is an advantage)

Previous experience in cleaning or other service-related roles

Apply today!
We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.
Read more and apply at www.hemfrid.se/karriar
If you have any questions, feel free to contact us at hr@hemfrid.se.
Welcome to Hemfrid – together we make everyday life easier for our customers! ✨

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer Industrial Automation & Machine Control
jobs.description:
Software Engineer Industrial Automation & Machine Control
to Ursviken Technology in Västerås
Ursviken Technology is expanding! We are establishing a new engineering office in Västerås and looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our growing international engineering team.
Are you passionate about software development, advanced automation, and intelligent industrial machines? Would you like to help shape the future of industrial technology while being part of something new?
This is an opportunity to work with advanced industrial machinery, develop machine control software, and contribute to the establishment of a new engineering office.
About Ursviken Technology
Ursviken Technology develops advanced CNC-controlled machinery for the sheet metal processing industry, including press brakes, shears, and automated manufacturing systems. With more than 140 years of industrial engineering experience, we are known for technical excellence, innovation, and customized machine solutions.
We are part of Vaski Group, a growing Finnish industrial technology group, and are investing in our engineering capabilities and future product development.
About the Role
As a Software Engineer specializing in Industrial Automation and Machine Control, you will develop and improve the software that powers our machines. You will work with both new machine development and existing products, contributing throughout the development process, from software design and programming to testing and commissioning.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Developing and maintaining PLC and machine control software.
Working with motion control, servo axes, hydraulics, and CNC-related functionality.
Integrating robotic systems and external automation equipment.
Testing, troubleshooting, and improving software solutions.
Collaborating with colleagues in software, automation, electrical engineering, and mechanical design.
Contributing to the development of common software platforms, reusable components, and engineering standards.

You will work with PLC programming in B&R Automation Studio, primarily using Structured Text (ST). The role may also involve C/C++ development for more advanced functions and integrations.
Technology Development and New Opportunities
We are strengthening our in-house software development capabilities and investing in our own machine control technologies. This creates exciting opportunities to contribute to new software architectures, shared platforms, and improved development methods.
You will also have the opportunity to help establish our new engineering office in Västerås, influence technical decisions, and collaborate with experienced engineers at our headquarters in Ursviken and across Vaski Group.
Who Are We Looking For?
We are looking for an engineer with a strong technical foundation and a genuine interest in programming, automation, and industrial machinery.
We believe you have:
A degree in automation, electrical engineering, mechatronics, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in PLC programming or industrial control software development.
An understanding of industrial automation and machine control.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
Good communication skills and fluency in English. Knowledge of Swedish is an advantage.

Experience with B&R Automation Studio, Siemens TIA Portal, Structured Text, C/C++, motion control, CNC technology, or industrial robot integration is an advantage. Most importantly, you are curious, take initiative, and enjoy developing reliable and maintainable software.
What We Offer
At Ursviken Technology, you will work with advanced industrial machinery and challenging engineering projects in an international environment. You will have the opportunity to influence our products, contribute to exciting technology development, and grow professionally as our organization expands.
You will join an established company with a long engineering history while helping build a new team and shape the future of our machine control systems.
If you enjoy combining software engineering with real-world machines and want to see your code bring powerful industrial equipment to life, this could be the perfect opportunity for you. Welcome to the team!
We look forward to receiving your application! We are collaborating with Skills Rekrytering for this recruitment. Please submit your application by November 22 via www.skillsrekrytering.se/lediga-jobb (https://www.skillsrekrytering.se/lediga-jobb?utm_source=chatgpt.com).
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Annika Frii at Skills Rekrytering on +46 70 335 52 90.

Senior Project Engineer – Control & Protection Software, Sequence & Interlocking HVDC
Our names are Andrew Carruthers and Richard Palm, and together we lead the teams responsible for Sequence & Interlocking within HVDC Control & Protection. Our work sits at the operational core of an HVDC station.
We define the logic that ensures equipment is operated safely and correctly. We develop interlocking principles, automated switching sequences, operating states, and the conditions that determine when a station is ready to perform a specific action. Our solutions help ensure that complex HVDC systems operate safely, predictably, and reliably throughout their lifecycle.
As HVDC technology continues to evolve, so do the challenges. New technologies, new customer requirements, and new ways of operating power systems continuously shape how we work. Success depends on our team members who can understand the bigger picture, exercise strong engineering judgement, and transform complex requirements into robust and reliable solutions.
We are looking for experienced engineers who enjoy technical ownership, system thinking, and solving challenging engineering problems together with highly skilled colleagues.
This is not a role for someone looking to simply execute predefined tasks. It is a role for you who want to understand how things work, influence technical decisions, and contribute to the future of HVDC technology.
“As managers, our goal is to create an environment where everyone can do their best work while continuing to develop their skills and expertise. We strongly believe in open technical discussions, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and a psychologically safe environment where questions, feedback, and continuous learning are encouraged. We value every person's voice and believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger.” Andrew Carruthers & Richard Palm, Hiring Managers
How you'll make an impact
Design and develop Sequence & Interlocking solutions for HVDC Control & Protection systems.
Transform system and customer requirements into robust operational logic and engineering solutions.
Work closely with system design, control, protection, testing, and commissioning teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Take technical ownership of specific functions, systems, or project areas.
Verify and validate solutions through testing, troubleshooting, and system integration activities.
Support commissioning activities and experience how your engineering decisions perform in the real world.
Drive technical discussions both internally and with customers.
Mentor and support less experienced engineers while contributing to the development of our team's technical capability.
Contribute to future methods, tools, and technical solutions within Sequence & Interlocking.

Your background
We care more about technical capability and your personal skills than matching every item on a checklist. You likely have:
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Control Systems, Power Systems, or a related discipline.
Several years of experience working with complex technical systems.
Experience in HVDC, FACTS, substation automation, protection and control systems, industrial automation, power systems, or similar fields.
Experience with commissioning, protection systems, relay applications, operational sequencing, or HVDC projects is highly valued.
Strong analytical skills and an ability to understand interactions across multiple systems and disciplines.
The confidence to challenge assumptions and contribute to technical discussions.
A structured approach and a curios mindset to engineering and problem solving.
The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others.
Professional communication skills in English.

Quality Engineer | QA Specialist
Technogarden is currently recruiting a Quality Assurance Specialist/Quality Engineer within Medtech to a Stockholm/Solna based client that manufactures and markets assistive technology that supports communication, cognition, environmental control and personal safety. The company's products help people with disabilities and special needs live more independent lives.

About the role
As a Quality Engineer/QA Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring product quality throughout the supply chain and manufacturing process.
Working across the entire product lifecycle, you will collaborate with colleagues in Development, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Regulatory Affairs, as well as with external suppliers.
You will contribute to continuous improvement by identifying risks, solving quality-related challenges and helping to strengthen quality processes across the organization. From time to time, you will also lead and/or coordinate quality related projects and improvement initiatives.

Quality systems and supplier quality

Data and analysis

You are a process-oriented person who works well independently but also enjoy collaborating across different functions and building strong relationships with colleagues and suppliers. You are curious, eager to learn and motivated by finding practical solutions that improve products and the way we work through our processes.
You enjoy combining analytical thinking with a practical approach to problem solving. You are proactive, structured and comfortable taking ownership of your work.
We believe you have
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Science or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
At least 2–5 years of experience within Quality Engineering and/or Quality Assurance, preferably in a regulated industry within medical device.
Good knowledge of quality management systems such as ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485.
Experience working with quality tools such as FMEA, Root Cause Analysis, 8D, CAPA or Six Sigma.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Professional communication skills in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

jobs.occupation: Team Lead, Electrical & Electronics Systems - Automotive
jobs.description:
Lead the engineers who make vehicles work

Every switch you press and every wire behind the panel has to work, every time. As Team Lead, you will guide a small team of E/E engineers who deliver wiring, switch and in-vehicle electrical system solutions to automotive customers. You stay close to the technical work while you own delivery, quality and the growth of your team. You will collaborate across electrical architecture, body electronics, and interior and HMI teams, and with customers and suppliers.

What you will do

Lead a team of 3–6 engineers on E/E development and integration assignments for customer vehicle programs.
Define and review wiring strategies, grounding and fuse concepts, and component layout against safety and manufacturability requirements.
Drive the development and validation of electrical switches, driver controls and wiring harnesses, including supplier follow-up.
Own technical troubleshooting of hardware, software and wiring anomalies, from vehicle test to root cause.
Support system verification: requirements management, diagnostics (UDS, ISO 14229) and automated test routines.
Apply structured problem solving and statistics (Six Sigma) to quality, warranty and failure-mode topics.
Be the technical and delivery contact for customers, and plan staffing, competence growth and delivery quality.

What you bring

MSc or BSc in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or equivalent.
8+ years in automotive E/E product development, including wiring, switches, instrument clusters or climate controls.
Experience leading engineers or work packages, formally or technically.
Strong supplier and cross-functional collaboration, including commercial and cost-reduction topics.
Working knowledge of vehicle diagnostics and CAN/UDS.
Fluent English, written and spoken.

Meriting, but not required

Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (Master Black Belt is a plus).
Python and SQL for data analysis and test automation.
Experience in failure-mode analysis, maintainability or warranty improvement.
Project management training (MBA, PMP or similar).
Experience with OEMs such as Volvo or Ford, or with Tier-1 suppliers.
Swedish language skills.

Working as a Consultant at Etteplan

As a senior consultant at Etteplan, you will work on exciting and complex assignments where your experience truly makes a difference. You combine the security of a stable employer with the opportunity to contribute to projects that are both technically challenging and span industries that impact people’s everyday lives and future. We see your experience as a key to finding smart, sustainable, and efficient solutions.

We offer an environment where you can continue to grow - whether you want to deepen your specialist expertise, lead projects, or act as an advisor. With us, you’ll meet both junior talents and colleagues with long experience, and together we drive innovative solutions that benefit both customers and society.

Application and Next Steps

You apply by uploading your CV and answering a few short questions related to the position. Selection and interviews are conducted continuously, so don’t hesitate to submit your application. The recruitment process begins with a phone interview and is followed by meetings with the responsible consulting manager and, if needed, additional colleagues. Our goal is to keep the process smooth so that together we can take the next step forward.

Do you feel that Etteplan is the right place for you? Submit your application today and become part of our team!

Etteplan is a leading technical consulting company shaping the industries of the future. With a dynamic and inclusive work culture, we offer exciting assignments, diverse customer relationships and an environment where your ambition can flourish. We are over 700 technology specialists in Sweden who are passionate about technology and people. Together, we shape the innovations and developments of the future within a global business environment. With us, there are many opportunities for those who want to grow and develop in a forward-looking organization.

Do you want to be part of a team that is developing tomorrow's businesses and organizations? At PwC, we strive to be proactive advisors that really make a difference in society. We see that experience and knowledge are invaluable assets, so it's crucial to us that you contribute with your expertise to promote PwC's development. Together, we create a meaningful and rewarding career for you.

Become part of PwC's audit operations

As an employee in audit, you work to identify risks, solve complex audit questions, analyze data and draw conclusions about the information presented by our customers. You get to work in inspiring and meaningful assignments where our work affects our customers' business operations, but also contributes to creating trust in society.

The digital development and increased demands for transparency contribute to the fact that the audit of the future will require more multifaceted competence than before, which also provides more opportunities for specialization. At PwC, working as an auditor can look very different and this means that you can create your own career path. You can choose to become a customer manager or immerse yourself in a specialist area such as data analysis, sustainability reporting, internal control or invest in a career as a leader.

Read more about our service areas within auditing

Who are you?

We are looking for you who have:

At least five years of experience working with auditing and/or Financial Reporting, Internal Controls and Compliance.
Experience from Big4
Experience in IFRS reporting, statutory audits and financial statement preparation.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

We attach great importance to your personal qualities and therefore believe that you:

Is service oriented and motivated by delivering results and meeting our customers' expectations.
Is adaptable, can read situations and adapt both behavior and communication in building qualitative and diversified relationships.
Acts with integrity by being straightforward and honest in communication and is easy to get others on board with
Has good analytical skills and is solution-oriented. You enjoy learning new things and are curious about digitization and new technology to be able to solve customers' needs.
Has interpersonal skills and the ability to create relationships and networks. These skills are needed to work well with our clients, but are of course also important for collaboration within our team.
Is structured, efficient and organized.

Recruitment Process

We will review applications continuously, and the position may be filled earlier than the application deadline.

Please attach the following documents to your application:

CV

We believe in having a recruitment process that applies to everyone. As part of the selection, we use psychometric tests to ensure an objective, unbiased, and fair selection.

We value the personal meeting to understand the value you can bring to PwC and what we can offer you. The interview process usually consists of multiple stages and various types of interviews. When meeting with HR, you will have a competency-based interview where we examine the personality test you completed before the interview. During the interview with the business, you will have the opportunity to meet with the relevant team to discuss the role. We call for interviews continuously, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For questions about the job or the recruitment process, contact the responsible recruiter below.

At PwC, we help our clients build trust and transform their businesses to enhance competitiveness. We are leaders in tax, audit, and advisory services and are part of a global network with 364,000 employees in 136 countries. By combining our expertise and experience with the latest technology, we assist our clients in becoming more efficient, adapting to changes, and always staying ahead.

PwC Sweden is an independent legal entity with over 3,000 employees across the country. Want to know more about PwC? Visit us at pwc.se or on LinkedIn.

HMS stands for Hardware Meets Software and we work to make the world more connected, productive, and sustainable. Our industrial communication products enable millions of machines, such as robots, drives, and air-conditioning systems, to connect with software and information systems – a necessity for meeting future demands for energy efficiency and sustainability.
We are now strengthening our Order Planning team and are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Planner who combines hands-on planning expertise with a passion for analysis and continuous improvement. 
Would you like to improve product availability and build reliable supply flows in an international environment? In this role, you will turn data into decisions, proactively address supply risks, and develop planning processes that make a difference to our customers and business. 
 
About the Role
As a Supply Chain Planner in our team, you will report to the Planning Manager. You will work closely with suppliers, production sites, logistics centers, and internal stakeholders to balance product availability with inventory costs and obsolescence risk.
You will combine operational planning with analytical work and long-term improvements. You will improve planning performance, address supply challenges, and drive cross-functional improvements while sharing expertise and supporting fellow planners.
Key Responsibilities:
Analyze customer demand and forecasts, firm planned purchases and maintain delivery schedules.
Evaluate and improve planning parameters, lead times, safety stock, and order quantities.
Identify supply risks and emerging shortages, drive mitigation and recovery plans, and escalate structural issues when needed.
Lead root-cause analysis of recurring delays, shortages, and excess inventory, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are implemented and followed up.
Monitor supplier confirmations, shipping schedules, carrier performance, and inbound deliveries, and optimize transport modes and delivery plans with relevant partners.
Proactively communicate supply risks, performance and recommended decisions across Logistics Centers and other stakeholders.
Drive improvements in planning processes where the ERP system is central
Lead or represent Order Planning in cross-functional supply chain and logistics projects, and coach planners by sharing expertise and best practices.

About You
We’re looking for a structured, proactive, curious and analytical planner who takes ownership and drives continuous improvement. You are comfortable balancing daily priorities with long-term development and influencing decisions across functions.
You bring:
Relevant education or equivalent professional experience in a related field.
Solid experience in supply chain planning, production planning and/or operational purchasing.
Hands-on ERP experience and a solid understanding of planning parameters, replenishment, lead times, safety stock, and inventory management.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and translate data into clear recommendations and actions.
Experience driving process improvements and collaborating with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders to improve supply performance.
Advanced Excel skills and practical experience using AI and other digital tools to analyze data and support decision-making.
You communicate effectively in Swedish and English with both internal and external stakeholders, locally and internationally.

Why Join Us?
Take a central role in a global team and improve product availability, inbound supply reliability and planning processes.
Work in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
Be part of a culture that values continuous improvement.
Be part of a fast-growing company with the ability to adapt quickly and turn ideas into action.

These core values not only make for a fitting abbreviation (HMS), but also describe how we work together and create success.We are an innovative growth company headquartered in Halmstad, Sweden, with approximately 1,100 employees in more than 20 countries. Through our global presence, we combine the opportunities of an international organisation with the close-knit and entrepreneurial spirit that has characterised HMS since the beginning.HMS is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels included, respected, and empowered.Visit hms-networks.com and learn more about life at HMS in our Working at HMS video.

The Opportunity
We, Hitachi Energy – Insulation and Components, are looking for you who would like to join us in the position Sales Application Manager! We are working within the transformer business, supplying world-class components to transformer manufacturers worldwide. We are proud of our product portfolio, our global customer base as well as our modern production units. Our strong ambition will always be to be our customers’ preferred choice of supply and hope that you will play a key role.
Are you a person with excellent leadership skills combined with strong technical expertise and a true interest in working close to customers and colleagues? Do you enjoy leveraging your team's expertise to support colleagues and customers and ensure that our solutions meet customer needs? Then this could be the right opportunity for you!
This is a newly created role, offering a unique opportunity to shape and develop the future Sales Engineering organization. As Sales Application Manager, you will have a significant impact on how the team operates, collaborates with stakeholders, and supports our colleagues and customers globally. You will lead a regional team of Sales Engineers supporting both Bushings and OLTC.
This position is with placement in Ludvika, Sweden.
How you’ll make an impact
Lead, inspire and develop a regional team of Sales Application specialists while maintaining active engagement with customers and key stakeholders
Apply the team's application expertise in Bushings and Tap-Changers to work closely with customers, sales, marketing and tendering teams, ensuring that our solutions meet customer needs.
Foster a highly collaborative environment with both internal and external stakeholders.
Actively participate in customer meetings, technical support activities, and sales application initiatives, including international travel.
Living our core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business

Your background
A minimum of three years’ engineering experience in Transformer/Bushings/OLTC technology.
Previous people-management experience within a technical or commercial environment.
Communicative and can explain advanced technical knowledge in a simple and easy way.
Strategic with a constant business mind, proven commercial experience in complex environments.
Fluency (written and spoken) in English is mandatory. Additional language skills such as Swedish, Spanish, German, or French are considered an advantage.
International travel required (approx. 20%)
